name: Rariki! ‐‐Chinko meets Girl!!‐‐
source:
One day, a group called the Holy Virgin Knights, made up of 144,000 virgins, appears and tries to build a kingdom of God on earth. Their plan is to allow only virgins to live in the world.

To protect the world from their conspiracies, Yagyu Minori, heir of the Yagyu family that has protected the world for generations, fights alongside with her friends.
translation:
有一天，由144,000名处女组成的名为圣贞女骑士团的组织出现，并试图在地球上建立一个神的王国。他们的计划是只允许处女生活在这个世界上。

为了保护世界免受他们的阴谋侵害，世代保护世界的柳生家族的继承人柳生实里与她的朋友们并肩作战。
